case_name: Sagar Taank & Ors vs The State Gnct Of Delhi & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sagar Taank & Ors (husband, wife, and relatives)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State GNCT of Delhi & Anr (wife's family)

facts_of_case: Petitioner husband and respondent wife got married in 2016. They started living separately in 2017 due to matrimonial differences. The wife filed a domestic violence case and a divorce petition, which were later withdrawn.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement agreement can dissolve a marriage.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 09.08.2021 and have agreed to dissolve their marriage by decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement agreement can be a full and final settlement of all claims.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner no.1 has also agreed to pay Rs.6,50,000/- to the respondent no.2 towards the full and final settlement of all her claims/legal entitlements (past, present and future) arising out of their marriage including permanent alimony/maintenance/istridhan etc.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no.0482/2018 dated 26.11.2018 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Sagar Pur are quashed.
